purpose: Preserve an immediately actionable integration boundary for a future authorized landing implementation without coupling the behavior core to Carolina-specific markup or styling.

integration_inputs.trigger: IntersectionObserver threshold or explicit programmatic trigger

mandatory_invariants: Do not recreate static suffix nodes with innerHTML.
Do not replace the containing statistic card during animation.
Keep accessible final values available independently of visual interpolation.
Prevent loop or automatic restart on viewport reentry unless separately approved.
Resize and orientation changes must not restart a completed sequence.
Cancel stale animation frames and timers before replay or teardown.
Do not introduce external runtime dependencies or network requests without separate approval.
recommended_product_adapter_sequence: Import statistics-counter-core.js into the target build or adapt it byte-traceably.
Resolve persistent target nodes after DOM and fonts are ready.
Create target descriptors using product values and timing tokens.
Connect the core once per mounted section.
Destroy the core during component unmount or navigation teardown.
Validate normal motion, reduced motion, reentry, resize, mobile widths and final DOM stability.
Obtain human review before product publication.

rollback.method: Remove the product adapter and restore the pre-integration section bytes.
